36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
145341: He is a founding member and the leader of Tokyo Manji Gang. Mikey is usually a carefree teenager who loves to joke and play pranks around those he considers his close friends. He cares for them greatly and is determined to protect their honor.
330136: Noko Shikanoko is a unique human-deer hybrid and the founder and mascot of the Deer Club at Hino Minami High School. She is a transfer student who becomes the best friend, classmate, and clubmate of Torako Koshi.
330137: Torako Koshi is a student at Hino Minami High School, and a highly respected one at that; being considered by many to be a "perfect girl". She is the classmate, best friend, and clubmate of Noko Shikanoko.
330138: Anko is a new student at Hino Minami High School, the 3rd official member of the Deer Club, and the younger sister of Torako Koshi.
330139: Meme Bashame is a new student at Hino Minami High School and the 4th official member of the Deer Club.
337285: Neko Nekoyamada is a student at Hino Minami High School, and the self-proclaimed rival of the Deer Club.
337286: Kinu Tanukikoji is a student at Hino Minami High School and a complete girlfailure, being extremely timid and overthinking almost everything.
337287: Chiharu Tsubameya is a student at Hino Minami High School. She initially appears to be a much calmer and more collected girl, having a cool and laid-back personality. So laid-back, in fact, that it is extremely difficult to figure out what she is thinking.
342963: The owner and sole barista of Swallow Cafe. He is the older brother of Tsubameya Chiharu.
343058: A deer cracker shop owner and winner of the DeerColle competition with Tsunoyama.
